title: The stall-watch tests stop asserting wall-clock bounds
why: Retrospective CI audit 15:53 CST Nov 12: hooks/test_stall_watch.py:287 and :452 assert secs <= 5.0 and <= 3.0, and the suite runs 195-330 s; this breaks decision test-strategy-reset rule 2 (no wall-clock bounds).
note: Replace both bounds with an event or count check that does not read the clock; red first on a slow runner stub. Express under R55 (CI fixes).
